text.tspan: Performance, Batch Operations and Storage Lens
Each prefix: at least 3,500 PUT/COPY/POST/DELETE and
5,500 GET/HEAD per second (course) · docs now say
11,000 GET/HEAD · latency ~100-200 ms · no limit on
recommended > 100 MB, must > 5 GB · parallel parts
file → nearby edge location → AWS private network
→ bucket in the target Region · works with multipart
parallel GETs of byte ranges · retry only a failed range
speed up downloads or read only part (file head)
Job = list of objects (manifest) + action + optional params
Copy · modify metadata/tags · replace ACLs · restore from
Glacier · invoke Lambda per object · Object Lock settings
S3 manages retries, tracks progress, notifies, reports
buckets, prefixes · default or custom dashboards
daily export to a bucket (CSV / Parquet)
